Russian Strikes Damage Kyiv Embassies, Netherlands Summons Envoy

Daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday, November 19, killed one person and damaged the embassies of the Netherlands and Austria, along with a historic cathedral. Following the incident, the Netherlands summoned the Russian ambassador.
